name: How long does exterior paint typically last in the DFW area?

mainEntity.name: How long does exterior paint typically last in the DFW area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of exterior paint in the DFW area can range from 5 to 15 years, depending on factors like the quality of paint used, surface preparation, and exposure to local weather conditions. Intense Texas heat and UV radiation can accelerate wear, so selecting a high-quality, weather-resistant paint formulated for extreme temperatures is a practical tradeoff for longer-lasting results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior paint in DFW typically lasts 5-15 years, influenced by paint quality, surface prep, and weather exposure. High-quality, weather-resistant paint is crucial for longevity.
